gates.detail: 6/6 agree [mean_mobility=0.70961 vs ref 0.70961; mean_complexity=1.9513 vs ref 1.9513; min_mobility=0.53195 vs ref 0.53195; max_diff_numpy=8.8818e-16 vs ref 0; max_diff_antropy=2.8447e-07 vs ref 0; n_channels=64 vs ref 64]
gates.citation: Hjorth B (1970). EEG analysis based on time domain properties. Electroenceph Clin Neurophysiol 29(3):306-310. Reference impls: antropy.hjorth_params (Vallat) + independent numpy (Harris et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Hjorth B (1970). EEG analysis based on time domain properties. Electroenceph Clin Neurophysiol 29(3):306-310. Reference impls: antropy.hjorth_params (Vallat) + independent numpy (Harris et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the Hjorth mobility + complexity per channel with an independent numpy implementation (unbiased n-1 variance, bit-exact) and antropy.hjorth_params (biased n variance), and reports the op's mean + minimum mobility, mean complexity, the bit-exact agreement vs numpy (~9e-16) and the near-match vs antropy (~3e-7, ddof convention), and the 64-channel count
